---
name: Request a report
about: Tell me the number you want out of Open Dental and I'll write the query
title: "[request] "
labels: request
---

**What number do you want?**
Plain English is fine — "how much did each hygienist produce last month", "who hasn't
been in for two years", "which insurance claims are older than 60 days".

**Your Open Dental version**
(Help > About. Column names move slightly between versions.)

**Anything that changes the answer**
Multiple clinics? Should broken appointments count? Should deleted procedures be
excluded (they usually should)? Anything unusual about how your office enters things?

---
Real questions get real queries added to the repo. If it's a big one and you'd rather
not wait, I write these to order too — but ask here first, most of them are quick.
